claims.limits: Threshold-based technical aim, not proof of medical safety or personal comfort.

claims.title: Proof-page semantics
claims.statement: Source, Prepared and Selection separate measurements, output checks and selected identity.
claims.limits: Read-only explanation, not runtime rescanning or authority to trust a new title.

claims.title: Build-time versus runtime identity
claims.statement: Media bytes are checked at build time; selection binds to expected route/map identities.
claims.limits: Do not imply the info page rehashes or reanalyzes all playback bytes.

claims.title: Missing analyzer version
claims.statement: McWay report lacks its output analyzer version and the UI says so.
claims.limits: Do not infer a version from another report. No flagged output segments does not demonstrate an activated protective cover.

claims.title: Remote reading improvement
claims.statement: Reading sections are focus stops and the validation records reaching the analysis record and returning with Back.
claims.limits: No full VoiceView or physical Fire TV acceptance is established. Total key counts include an earlier build, so this package does not promote them as final-build counts.

claims.title: Need and intended impact
claims.statement: Published flashing guidance and photosensitivity context motivate an inspectable prepared-library workflow.
claims.limits: No fresh source-page verification, interviews, adoption, market sizing, medical outcome or comfort measurement.

claims.title: Differentiation
claims.statement: This implementation combines preparation, exact-edition checks, guarded playback and a readable proof record.
claims.limits: Describes this project, not a first/only claim or assertion about competitor limitations.
